title: The Open Ant: A Robot Platform for Reinforcement Learning Research
description:
arXiv:2607.18488v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) research has demonstrated success in both physical and simulated domains; however, the predominant methodology remains rooted in simulations. The predominance of simulations makes translating research to physical reality uncertain for both algorithms and researchers.
